units.source_text: “看样子这盘棋封棋期间，不论是名人还是大竹，都没有作过研究。

en.t: It seems that during the sealed-move interval of this game, neither the Master nor Otake did any study of it.

units.source_text: 大竹也是个性格上有怪癖的人，因此名人生病期间，他也不愿意研究。”

en.t: Otake, too, was a man with peculiarities in his character, and so while the Master was ill, he also did not want to study the game.
Perhaps that was exactly how things stood.
